measures.description: Percentage of episodes for members 3 years and older diagnosed with pharyngitis, dispensed an antibiotic, and who received a group A streptococcus (strep) test.

Culture, presumptive, pathogenic organisms, screening only
Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay technique
Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid; Streptococcus, group A
